description: A shell command still producing output at its deadline returns control to the model promptly as a bg handoff (not killed, not an error) instead of stalling inside process cleanup. The 3s window leaves room for login-shell + interpreter startup on Windows before the first print.
prompt: Run the bounded shell check and report what happened.

script.text: The command is still running in the background and control returned.

stdout_contains: The command is still running in the background and control returned.
